recipes.name: Rice noodle salad with chicken and herbs
recipes.method_note: Fish sauce smells strong from the bottle. In the dressing it just tastes savoury.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:rice-noodles-dry}} following the packet. Drain. Rinse in cold water.
Slice {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} thinly.
Fry in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} on a high heat for 6 minutes, until cooked through.
Squeeze the juice from {{ing:lime}} into a jar.
Add {{ing:fish-sauce}} and {{ing:honey}}. Chop {{ing:chilli-fresh}} finely and add.
Put the lid on. Shake until the honey dissolves.
Grate {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Cut {{ing:cucumber}} into thin sticks.
Pick the leaves from {{ing:fresh-mint}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Chop {{ing:peanuts}} roughly.
Toss noodles, vegetables, herbs and chicken with the dressing. Top with peanuts.

swaps.text: Firm tofu or a tin of chickpeas, for a vegetarian version
Soy sauce, for a vegetarian version
Toasted sunflower or pumpkin seeds, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Ginger chicken noodle soup, pho style
recipes.method_note: The broth is the point. Taste it before serving and add lime or fish sauce to suit.

steps.instruction: Halve {{ing:onion-medium}}. Slice {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Put a dry frying pan on a high heat. Char the onion and ginger 5 minutes.
steps.note: Blackened in places is right. It sweetens the broth.

steps.instruction: Put them in a large pan with {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Add {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} whole. Simmer (small bubbles) 20 minutes.
Lift out the chicken. Shred it with two forks.
Stir {{ing:fish-sauce}} into the broth.
Soak {{ing:rice-noodles-dry}} following the packet. Drain.
Share noodles and chicken between four bowls.
Ladle the broth over, leaving the onion and ginger behind.
Top with {{ing:beansprouts}}, {{ing:fresh-coriander}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and sliced {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.
Serve with wedges of {{ing:lime}}.

swaps.text: Firm tofu or a tin of chickpeas, for a vegetarian version
Soy sauce, for a vegetarian version
Vegetable stock, alongside the other vegetarian swaps
